name: Octypo
description: Turns feeds and your documents into source-checked articles, in any language.

paths.name: Data
paths.description: The database (postgres/), the engine's encrypted secrets file (octypo/) and the passwords made on first start (state/). Back up the whole folder.

ports.name: Web UI
ports.description: Octypo admin panel (/admin) and REST API, published on host as 6719

variables.name: TZ
variables.description: Your time zone, like Europe/London or America/New_York.

variables.name: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY
variables.description: A model key, needed to write articles. Use this one, or add OPENAI_API_KEY, GEMINI_API_KEY or GROQ_API_KEY instead (Variables tab).

variables.name: ADMIN_PASSWORD
variables.description: The admin panel password. Leave it empty to have one made; it is shown in the app's logs, in the box marked CREDENTIALS.
